one_liner: Only Janitor Plus subscribers see it: a game moves their replies ahead of the priority routing they already pay for.
author: claude-opus-5-5

change.title: Existing opportunity: Top-priority replies for an hour for Janitor Plus members
change.what_is_different_here: Janitor+ sells priority routing for faster replies (s02.e06). A subscriber who opens the profile menu (s09) already has it, so the card offers a lane above it: for an hour, their replies go ahead of other subscribers' priority replies. It costs no extra replies, only earlier placement in line.
change.trigger_event: A Janitor Plus subscriber opens the profile menu
change.placement: Card at the top of the profile menu drawer
change.offer_copy: Play a short sponsored game to put your replies at the front of the Janitor Plus priority lane for the next 60 minutes.
change.subscriber_treatment: Only Janitor Plus subscribers see this card. It moves them ahead of the priority routing their plan already gives, and it is always optional.

flow_steps.caption: A subscriber opens the profile menu.
A card at the top offers top-priority replies for 60 minutes for one short sponsored game.
The subscriber plays the short sponsored game and can quit at any time.
The card confirms top-priority replies are on for 60 minutes, and the subscriber goes back to their chats.

change.after_reward: When the hour ends, replies go back to the plan's usual priority routing, and the card offers one more hour tomorrow.
change.rationale: Subscribers already feel the speed of priority routing, so a faster lane on top is a reward they can notice at once. It adds no extra replies, so it is cheap to give, and it earns from users who already pay.
